title: CJ L NDE 3371
content: I remember most everything that happened when I walked into the emergency room. The people started rushing around; the charge nurse kept talking with me. I told her that I was tired and just wanted to close my eyes for a moment. She said not to do that or they would have to put tubes and such in places I wouldn't like, we all laughed nervously. I remember asking them to save my Rockies shirt! They did! A tech was going to insert a catheter tube. I remember closing my eyes and letting out a breath. Then I found myself very alert thinking it doesn't sting, I felt very much at peace. It was dark and I could feel I was moving to my right, floating fast. I thought at first to yell echo, then thought it would be inappropriate. My next thought was, 'this is it!' I prayed the Lord's Prayer, and I don't remember the other prayer, I recall thinking, 'Now I get to sing!!' At that moment, I had a rush like when you fall in a dream. I was upset about being taken away from there! I sat up and looked around saying do you have heating pads under me it's hot take them out! It was the electricity from being shocked back. I know now that I (coded) on the table for about thirty seconds. I was also told, I did not just close my eyes. I grabbed the nurse's arm and gave her a look they call the death stare! I let out a gasp and fell back on the table. I do recall at some time I could feel my left arm and right leg hanging off the table but I couldn't lift them, like I was not connected to them. I don't recall when that happened. Everything is different now! I'm glad to know I'm not alone in my experience.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Returned after being shocked/defibrillated ('electricity from being shocked back').

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Prayer during the experience (Lord's Prayer); 'rush like when you fall in a dream'; return associated with defibrillation.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like alertness/peace followed by dark rapid floating movement; abrupt return with shock.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Concern about saving a shirt ('save my Rockies shirt'); thought about yelling 'echo' but decided it would be inappropriate; sensation of limbs hanging off table and not connected; feeling heat on return attributed to 'electricity from being shocked back.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then I found myself very alert… I felt very much at peace. It was dark and I could feel I was moving to my right, floating fast.”; “My next thought was, 'this is it!'”; “I was upset about being taken away from there!”; “I know now that I (coded) on the table for about thirty seconds.”
